title: Repo Basket
description: repo-basket/v1 — the document a basket-registered event carries. The basket is created FOR the trade the event cites: a DTCC collateral account plus the quantity-1 FinP2P basket asset in front of it, with the trade's dates and parties fixed at creation (design 3.4).

basketKey.description: Stable key the apps use for the basket; the event id is the key the guards use.

chainId.description: CAIP-2 chain id of the DTCC collateral account.

basketAssetId.description: FinP2P asset id of the basket asset (quantity 1).

source.description: On-chain address collateral is deposited from (A's).

destination.description: On-chain address collateral is forwarded to on default (B's).

controller.description: Org id of the account controller (B, or the tri-party agent).
